note: The paper numbers nothing: no Figure N, no Table N, no caption line anywhere in the text layer, so 48 measured exhibits are recorded uncaptioned and the record cannot report a printed-count gap. Two conventions carry weight here. First, the four leaf silhouettes on p6 and the outline pairs on p15 are shape keys, recorded as other rather than as photographs. Second, the 0.5 cm grid illustrations are photographed leaves with a vector overlay drawn on them; they stay photo-or-raster-image and are counted as the six measured stages of two illustrations, not as one exhibit. Unresolved: none by name - nothing in the paper is named and unmeasured - but the figure that the text calls 'the plot of data' on p23 has no printed caption, so its four panels are identified by the four printed 'Profile n:' fragments only.
rules: The paper prints no exhibit numbers and no caption lines, so every row is uncaptioned and every mention block is empty: first_page stays null rather than borrowing the nearest prose sentence [mention.first_page].

The one caption the paper does print for a figure is set as a bordered text box inside the figure itself, so caption.verbatim quotes that sentence and the block holding the box is excluded as a fragment of the composite [caption.verbatim].
Family follows the ink: a flat labelled leaf silhouette is neither a photograph nor a plot, so the six shape glyphs are recorded as other with an other_note saying what they are [geometry.family].

Rendered scenes are surface-or-3D even when they are pictures of a real tree, because the ink is a computer rendering inside a projected axis box; only the one outdoor photograph of the camphor is photo-or-raster-image [geometry.family].
The enum has no value for a perspective projection, so three_d reads isometric on every rendered scene and the notes say which of them print tick numbers [geometry.three_d].

A raster of a ruled table is a table-as-figure exhibit, not a measured table: the p15/p16 profile comparison is split over the page break into two blocks and neither carries a measurable grid [geometry.family].
One measured block can hold a whole multi-panel figure: p16-r2 carries a 3D scatter, two 2D scatters and a text box, recorded once as composite-panel with panel_count 4 [geometry.panel_count].

A re-printed artwork is still an exhibit: p12-r1 repeats the p11-r3 globe and loops with two arrows added, and is recorded as its own item with the re-use named in the note rather than excluded as a duplicate [geometry.family].
Section paths stop at the deepest extracted heading on the page, so the 2.2.2 sub-pictures carry 2.2.2.1 and the case-study pages carry 5.3.1 and 5.3.2 [place.section_path].
